open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt.authority referencing a FlowActivation
open_points.text: "authority: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation under which the run started"
open_points.question: When authority is a flow activation, what exact identifier/facts must be stored to point to that activation record, given M18 defines FlowActivation as an entity but gives no activation id field?
options: Add a minted `flow_activation_id` to M18 and store it in M26.authority
Reference activation by composite facts (for example `flow_version_id` + `activated_at`)
Do not reference a specific activation record; store only authority kind `flow_activation` and infer from run pinning
open_points.default_guess: Reference by composite facts (`flow_version_id` + `activated_at`) because M18 currently has no explicit id.

open_points.subject: M28 Installation change application (non-token fields)
open_points.text: "the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed" and "manifest_location, `manifest_revision`: ... read by every manifest reading (M10), so a record changes for the kernel only when the owner changes the configured revision"
open_points.question: Do changes to installation fields other than token list (especially `manifest_revision`, `service_instances`, `service_credentials`) take effect only after restart, or can they take effect live while the process runs?
options: Only token-list changes are live; all other installation changes require restart
All installation fields are watched and can change live
Mixed policy (some non-token fields live, others restart-only)
open_points.default_guess: Treat non-token installation fields as restart-only, with live reload limited to token list.
